items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s been compared to a Waiting for Godot kind of . . . Something like that.

ctx.x: Stretched, made for enjoyment, yeah, but it was about that, waiting for the connection to come, because you got something that you need.
It’s been compared to a Waiting for Godot kind of . . .
Something like that. That’s true. They did a lot of Bertolt Brecht and other plays that – I really got introduced to theater through my experience with The Connection.
